title: Change the desk
lede: Who to ask, and what needs code.

slides.cap: Anything a screen can't change goes to the desk's owner.

notes.html: Never write the team password anywhere else.

steps.title: The owner and the password
items: The team password is the one password. Content Sort and Research briefs ask for it, Publish and Highlight ask for it at Confirm, and so does the Exchange's edit door.
It is in READ ME FIRST - ERC handoff, in the shared drive, with the owner's name.

steps.title: A change in code
items: With access to the repo, Claude Code can make the change, and a push to main is live in a minute. The table under these slides says where each part lives.

slides.cap: Logos, words and section names are code in the Exchange's GitHub repo. Open it in Claude Code and say what to change.

steps.title: Where each part lives
items: Section names: NEWS_TABS in js/app.js, and the top bar of about/, newsletter/ and share/
